ideas.idea: Remove the Bingbot block from robots.txt
ideas.why: This is a known problem, but it is also listed as item 1 and so should not be counted; it is excluded.

ideas.idea: Use a Remix loader for changelog entries
Add a pricing meta export with title, description and canonical
Add concrete plan names and prices to the pricing copy, plus Product/Offer JSON-LD
ideas.why: Pricing says only 'Talk to us for a quote', so concrete plans give something to cite; the JSON-LD part is optional but the copy fix is specific.

ideas.idea: Add Disallow for ClaudeBot, anthropic-ai, Google-Extended, CCBot, Applebot-Extended and Bytespider to match the trainingCrawlers: block policy
ideas.why: The config says to block training crawlers but robots.txt covers only GPTBot, so the policy isn't enforced.

ideas.idea: Keep search and retrieval crawlers (OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, PerplexityBot, Claude-SearchBot) unblocked
ideas.why: This matches the aiSearchCrawlers: allow policy and keeps the training-bot blocks from catching search bots.

ideas.idea: Explicitly list search crawlers with Allow: / in robots.txt
ideas.why: The * rule already allows them, so explicit entries only make the policy visible and change nothing.

ideas.idea: Replace the div onClick with a Link to /features
ideas.why: Known problem (/features reached only by a div onClick); excluded.

ideas.idea: Add Home and Features to the root nav and use Link
ideas.why: The nav in root.tsx really lists only Pricing and Changelog, so adding /features gives it a crawlable link on every page.

ideas.idea: Name specific integrations on the home page and expand the features copy with h2 sections
ideas.why: The home page says 'all the tools you already use' without naming any, and features.tsx has one generic sentence.

ideas.idea: Add FAQ content with FAQPage JSON-LD
ideas.why: This relies on the mandatory-FAQ folklore, and the user said JSON-LD isn't a required fix.

ideas.idea: Add Organization, WebSite and SoftwareApplication JSON-LD
ideas.why: The user said having no JSON-LD is not a required fix.
This is accurate since none are present, but it applies to almost any site and has little effect.

ideas.idea: Add og:* and twitter:* tags to each page's meta
ideas.why: This is accurate and standard for any site, but it does little for crawler discovery or understanding.

ideas.idea: Add a viewport meta tag and a charset tag in head
ideas.why: Root.tsx has neither, which is true, but this advice applies to almost any site.

ideas.idea: Improve the root default title and description beyond 'Atlas'
ideas.why: The pages with their own meta override it, so it has little effect.
